decisive_items: Black eschar on the nasal root
presence of large amount of fungal hyphae and spores
Detected 22 sequence reads of Rhizopus microsporum
response.rationale: The black eschar, pansinusitis, histologic fungal hyphae, and mNGS detection of Rhizopus/Mucor in a diabetic patient are pathognomonic for mucormycosis. COVID-19 is only a preceding risk factor, and DKA is not supported by labs (no ketosis/acidosis).

rejected.why: COVID-19 is a prior infection and not the cause of the acute facial swelling, eschar, and fungal findings.
Diabetic ketoacidosis is not supported; there is no evidence of ketones, acidosis, or typical DKA presentation.
